Tabatha: A very sexy, quirky and occasionally very clumsy private eye. And, yes, she's useless at not being discovered.
Tabitha: Tabitha is a small furry mammal. She is nocturnal and hunts small rodents that, like her, prowl the forest floor in search of food. If you try to pick her up when she’s awake you will receive nasty bites and scratches to your hands and cheeks.
Tabrett: Tabrett loves visiting casinos in a slinky dress. Especially when there are a heap of doting men around who are happy to buy all of her drinks.
Tabytha: Doesn't matter how many times you tell Tabytha she can't or shouldn't do something, she'll do it. (And if things don’t work out she’ll still cry about it afterwards.)
Tahisha:
Like Guy way after her, Tahisha has no great plans to age beyond about 20. In her mind people of 30 years and over represent ancient relics and she's amazed they can even walk. Ask her if she has plans to get a job one day and she'll look at you vacantly. 
“Whaaaa? Whaddaya mean?”
Tahlah: Tahlah, we love you, but your parents need a good clip around the ears. Where is the rock of fortitude in your name? The hard edge of grit required when a dodgy situation inevitably presents itself? Or have you accepted this challenge and risen up against this inversely presented obstacle? So, if you haven't already, STAND UP, STICK YOUR BOOBS OUT, BACK STRAIGHT, & BE SPLENDID! (And obviously ignore anything we say if you're in this zone already. Amen.)
Tahlia: Tahlia could quite easily handle the helm of a yacht that is tearing down the face of a giant swell out there in the Southern Ocean, the lives of her twelve crew-members in her hands. She paid for the yacht with the money she collected from when she was 8 years old. If you swore near her you had to pay her $2. By the time she was 12 it was upped to $5. At 17 it had tripled to $15 and at 21 it was $25 a go. She stopped at 22. She'd already made her fortune.
Tahlija: Tahlija, I think you're another one who suffers from the syndrome that we call, Parents Idioticus. Don't they know that girls hate it when people mis-spell their name? Anyway, T, you're a nice person, and you're plodding along in the correct direction, which is more than we can say for mum and dad, eh? If you can, head towards university, only because it’s harder to go back later than to dive into it early. But yes, you have to want to be there. Love, Management.
Tahn: Yep, she's a crazy one, alright. For instance, see that haunted house on the corner? That old deserted place? Yeah?.....Okay, now listen….can you hear that screaming coming from inside? Hear those doors slamming?......Well they're not ghosts, that's Tahn running around up there. She does it every Friday night after a few drinks. It scares the hell out of her, but she just loves it. She might even NEED to do it, I'm not sure.....
Talei: Another innocent girl whose mother thought that all actresses must have weird names.
Taleisha: Real estate agent? I don't think so. She can't count past 50. But, she speaks the truth and her radar for wankers/idiots is exceptional. How did she pull this off? No one knows. We certainly don't.
Talena: "Hang on!" she says, her face all screwed up in disgust. "This is decaff! Who ordered this crap? Here, waiter, pour this shit out and give me a real coffee, will you?"
Talia: Talia doesn't get jaded easily. Frustrated, sure, but not jaded. Indeed, usually she doesn't run from drama, she actively leans into it.
Talica: Taliba, Taliwa, Talipa, Talina….you could probably keep on going forever. I presume they're humans and not doleful, agreeable robots. Anyway, Talica doesn't complain much until her credit runs out on her smart phone. Then she whinges like a cat up a telephone pole who hasn't eaten anything for a week.  But, yes, she's a nice enough girl and for many friends/parents it's as much as you can hope for sometimes.
Taliha: Taliha has destroyed so many cars it isn't funny. No, she generally doesn't crash them, although this has happened, it's more a case of her not considering that there might be more to life that just the shop front. Yes, she understands a car needs fuel, for example, and a car key, but not much else. The trick here, Taliha, is to remember to breathe deeply and to investigate the various aspects of life more thoroughly than you do. (Great friends with Letitia.)
Talisha: Talisha sends too many naked or semi-naked pics of herself to boys or men who are, let’s face it, not sharpest tools in the box. So, darling, just stop that, pronto. Don’t buy into all this social media bullshit. And if all your friends are into this as well, tell them to desist, also. Send them your smile and nothing else, if need be. Better yet, actually meet and talk and get them to look into your eyes and not at your boobs. Good luck.
Talita: A nice girl who works at the local bakery.
Talitha: For a pretty chilled-out lady, Talitha never lets an opportunity pass. As a modern networker, she's almost unbeatable. With one eye secretly on her watch - she has a very busy schedule she needs to stick to - she will franternise at the party with a host of people, who have no idea they are being secretly vetted. She still has a nice time though, and so do the people she meets. It's quite a skill, and says something of her eternally optimistic nature.
Tallow: So, she was conceived in Byron Bay, Australia, eh? Nice work, if that’s the case. Anyway, Tallow is a delightful, gentle soul who’d benefit from a steak every six weeks or so. Her hippie heritage will remain with her forever and she says a prayer after accidentally killing a bug.
Tallula: Very expressive in everything she does, Tallula makes a great feast but, honestly, you should see the kitchen when she's finished with it. Dinner guests have taken photos of it. She's the same in bed, give or take.
Tallulah: Like her sister immediately above, Tallulah’s parents ran away with the circus and life has been one long adventure, even before she was born. It’ll probably persist into the next life as well.
Talori: As much as she loves them, her friends bore her most of the time. Not because they're droll or useless, but because Talori has her eyes on the world outside, and she's aching to get out amongst it and see what it has to offer. So, do what you have to do Talori, but don't burn your bridges 'cause everyones on the same mission of discovery. Good luck!
Tals: Whether it's Natalia's nickname or some other derivative, Tals (pronounced Tarls) does very little by halves and she is not the dainty type. That doesn't mean she's not sexy, far from it, but she gets her hands dirty and gets down to the grit of her creative passion. No way would you see her dating a dainty male accountant, type.
Tam: The gorgeous sister, friend, lover and mum. From whichever road Tam has emerged from to meet you in your life, she has arrived with a purpose and a message. Fierce in her defence of those she cares for, her only failing, if you can call it that, is that an ill-wind might distract her from which particular ball she needs to currently catch, and Christ knows she tends to juggle many at once. This is the life, and this is the lovely Tam.
Tamar: There's a sheer rock face in Yosemite National Park, USA, that the best rock climbers flock to, and occasionally die at. Tamar has free-climbed it twice - ie. No ropes. Just her. She's that kind of girl.
Tamara: Tamara rhymes with ‘Get out of the Way’. You’ll often see her bursting out of a flame-filled house covered in soot, grime and perspiration, with an axe in one hand and a child in the other. She’s won so many bravery awards it isn’t funny. She keeps them on a shelf in the toilet.
Tameika: Tameika? Timid? Not a chance. Purposeful and direct, Tameika speaks her mind and is prepared to take the jump if she believes she can make it, which is her other great trait. Unlike many people in the Kingdom, Tameika generally knows what she wants and understands her capabilities. Not shy with the boys either, usually..
Tameka: Like all of us, Tameka is largely a product of her surroundings and her friends. However, some of them aren't the brightest sparks, let's face it, and their ideas about how to behave, react and plan are bizarre to say the least, as well as not being that far-reaching in their scope. So, Tameka, we up here in Management think that, when the time is right and you've got some cash together, get yourself on a plane, leave your friends behind and fly to somewhere a long way away for a slice of how the other half live. It'll open your mind and enrich your heart, and on your return we'll sit down and see what you want to do. How about that?
Tamerelle: Tamerelle never just zips down the beach with only a towel and an idea for a quick dip and a quick sun-bake. There is planning, there are creams and lotions to take, sunglasses we need, thongs too, but not the red towel - there is system. What if something happens and I haven't got money on me? What if I'm not prepared?...etc etc
Tamieka: Rarely not primed and ready, Tamieka doesn't scare easily although it does take her a while to wind up properly. Sometimes years. But her arrival into a confident, diligent space is inevitable. She'd make a power-packed circus performer, although if she ever she were involved with the knife throwing team, she'd be the one letting them go, no question.
Tamika: You've seen the news reports about the Running of the Bulls in Pamplona, Spain, right? Inevitably at least one hapless tourist is stomped and gored to death by a big, beautiful bull with razor-pointed horns. Well, unbeknowns to the humans involved, the bulls actually conduct a little bet before the event on who they think is going to kill and maim the most people. While not always the victor, Tamika generally attracts the most money. She's one of the few bulls to have a personal fitness trainer for instance, so I supose you can't blame the rest for thinking she'll prevail, again. (In a past life her and Theresa were actually sisters.)
Tamille: Shoosh! Come here so I can whisper it to you.......can you hear me? Good, now, Tamille......well, you were right. She's a bloody Freedom Fighter. I'm serious. The government is after her because people who seek the truth and justice as much as she does are a threat to 'the system'. Know what I mean?
Tammee: Tammee has watched the Shawshank Redemption 50 times and while we all love a good DVD, Tam, darlin', for a change, for something totally fucking wild, throw out thy cursed DVD machine. Open the windows and throw the bloody thing out. It’ll have the nice side effect of letting in some fresh air. In fact, fuck it, you might as well throw the TV out as well. It's time to get outside and to get fit. The End.
Tammy: The name of a beautiful soft blanket that you wrap yourself in on a cold night before slouching on the couch for a bit of TV. The only thing you have to watch out for is a single large hole about as big as a basketball and, depending on where it is located, you may be forced to wrestle with a chilly breeze on a part of your body that will make it difficult to relax for very long. So, can you see the hole?
Tamsin: A type of knot used on boats. They’re excellent in foul weather but impossible to undo.
Tamsyn: Tamsyn makes an excellent look-out in the crow's nest of a sailing ship. Not only does she spot obstacles quickly, she's far too unstable to have her milling with the crew on deck. She loves getting into a bit of strife, you understand.
Tamzin: What do you do? You're late, but your face or legs or bikini line is in dire need of a wax or a shave, and all you have is that bloody Tamzin Razor which is as blunt as hell. You've got no choice really but to be brave and forge on! (No whinging permitted.)
Tan: Tan leans across a smoke-filled bar at two in the morning, with a fag in her hand, a sneaky smirk stuck to her face and a recently emptied shot glass in front of her. She’s smiling increasingly at some ridiculous story that a drunken friend is telling her, about some other twit who did something stupid, before she pipes up. “Oh yeah,” she drones, “…like one of those beige bastards.”
Tanara: Tanara takes some time to finish things, indeed, occasionally she forgets projects (like some boys) as soon as she’s started and just walks away forever. Is she distracted or just involving herself in things in which her heart is not? It’s hard to say. We think she’ll get there though, but it might take a while, that’s all.
Tanaya:
Tanaya, I have a task for you? Now, see this globe of the world (yes, you live on planet that is actually spherical), I want you to point to Australia, Canada, South America and then the Pacific Ocean, in that order. Can you do that?.....I'll just go and grab a coffee while you put down that magazine and take off those  sunglasses...

Note: She finds it very hard to walk in a dead-straight line.
Tandia: As a younger girl she was something of a brat. Did she grow out of that? We up here in the commentary box have been searching for her name in the team list and we can't find her. Does she not want to play?
Tania: What you see is what you get. Tania is a sexy and vivacious girl who is always surprised at how well her salon is going.
Tanisha: Note to Tanisha: 1. Throw away all trashy magazines. 2. Eat healthily for three weeks. 3. Remove all smartphones and tablets from your surrounds. Email is allowed. 4. And most importantly, get outside each day and bust a gut doing some voracious exercise so it feels as though your heart is about to burst from your chest. Three weeks, Tanisha - it isn't much - but just see what happens to your body and soul. Good luck!
Tanith: Like Sue, Lyn and Merryl, Tanith is usually encumbered with the task of planning well for her mob. Indeed, she may well be a begrudging matriarch. She is very intelligent, no matter if she's a rural lass or not, and in the case of her not having children (yet or never) she spends a lot of time single because, let's face it, most men bore the shit out of her and she hasn't got time for their crap.
Tanja: Why is it that women are more bothered by a misspelling of their name than men? Anyway, Tanja was a nightmare at day care and when she's in a foul mood as an adult, leave town. Having said that, Tanja is busy and industrious, and she loves her Friday nights.
Tannis: Rarely expansive in her displays of emotion, if Tannis fervently disagrees with what someone is saying at a dinner party, for instance, she'll keep her trap shut. She may not want to create a scene, or perhaps she's just a bit shy. She's no fool though. Not at all. And her long and lithe figure means she looks wonderful in an evening gown.
Tanya: Sure, she might be a genial mortgage broker, but Tanya is a pretty normal girl, if such a thing exists. You’d never find her at the bottom of a 12 foot hole on an archaeological dig in Greece, for instance, but you would find her yelling after her kids after they jumbled out of the car for school, asking them if they packed their lunches. In her younger day, she even had the odd one night stand.
Taola: Taola is the name of that great friend you haven't seen for years, who arrives on your door a happy, exhausted and dusty mess, and who, after a 90 minute shower, leaves the bathroom in a spectacularly calamitous state, the likes of which you haven't seen since the two of you backpacked through Asia together, 15 years ago. Some things never change, god bless her. Hopefully she'll stay long enough to divulge all of her stories...
Tara: Tara inhabits a body from the Gods and lives in the ancient city of Atlantis. She wears a thin white gown that is partially see-through and everyone wants to hang out with her – be they man or woman.
Tarahnee: The name of that exquisitely beautiful pang of pain you get in your throat after sculling a full glass of fizzy saline drink that you gulp down when it’s maximally bubbling, when you’re dying of thirst. God, she’s good....
Tarika: It's gotten to the point now that car insurance companies simply wont insure her.
Tarnee: Tarnee rarely gets the blues and she deplores those who love to wallow. Is she a little manic? Well, yes, I suppose she can be, but this goes for plenty of people.
Tarni: Tarni hangs out with Tamika. Spain.
Tarryn: Often sexy and invariably complex, T is a no-nonsense girl who would prefer to put her feet up and do nothing rather than get to heavily involved, which always seems to happen, for some reason. Has she found her purpose yet?…anyone?
Tarsh: Every weekend she heads into the bush with the sole goal of hunting, felling, dismembering and then feasting upon a wild pig which, hopefully, she dispatched with only a giant hunting knife. Have you ever seen a woman more determined? She trains hard, her knife is bloody sharp and she selects her hog very carefully. Some are just too big to mess with.
Taryn: Hi Taryn. Yep, one r and two r’s make no difference here. It seems therefore that you are sexy and complex. You’re a no-nonsense girl and you would prefer to put your feet up and do nothing rather than get involved, which always seems to happen, for some reason. Have you found your purpose yet? That’ll solve everything. Love Management. x
Tasara: Cute and proactive, Tasara rarely finds herself stuck, no matter if it’s out on a 4WD track or inside a dull relationship. Perhaps she’s occasionally a little arrogant about it all, but we’d suggest a little arrogance in some situations goes a long way.
Tash: Tash is an energetic and sensual being whose main goal in life is fun-seeking, but there’s more to her than that. Her relaxed nature is welcomed by everyone although she will gladly hurl herself into the action if prompted by love, hate or need. (Note: The blonde Tash is more irreverent than the brunette Tash, not to mention more common, although this is probably a function of men giving more attention to blondes and thus allowing them more space to be silly, basically.)
Tasha: Tasha = pools, champagne, drinking, friends, obnoxious friends, weird men, fun jobs for 6 months then boredom, cars that you bought 5 years ago and still go strong, and a career change. She says she does yoga.
Tashan: Tashan is the kind of girl who, after surprising her partner by telling them to meet her at a swank hotel for a sexy night out, discovers three hours later that she gave him the name of the wrong hotel. Moral to the story, Tashan? Slow down for a second and check your work!
Tasja: Well, she may not be from Eastern Europe, but by god you wouldn't know it from watching her drive, kiss, drink and generally speak the truth like a bullet shot out of a gun. Sure, her ego ain't little and she expects a fair bit of her lovers and comrades, but this is Tasja. She's no retiring little violet, so don't be fooled by the sexy smile!
Tasman:
A sensitive, intelligent human being, sexy too, who many describe as the real deal. Tasman is funny, she doesn’t talk shit and she’ll help out if and when needed although she struggles with many of the city girls who are obsessed by achieving some kind of perfect ‘look’. 
Tasman, we salute you.
Tasmin: Maintenance engineer on anything large enough that you need a hard hat if you're going to get near it. Tasmin is respected by all the men who do what she says without question. She's good at her job, she knows the machinery here back to front and she cares about the welfare of the crew.
Tatiana: Racing stripes were painted on her body at birth and I say again, we all have a niche to fill! You go chick!
Taya: Completely capable and cool under pressure, Taya is the publicist/stage manager with the clipboard in her hand. You can’t see her because of the dozen people in front of her who are trying desperately to get her attention. You see, Taya is the gatekeeper and none of these journos and groupies will get anywhere near the stars without her say so. And she never panics, ever. She’d tell you she’d like a minute to sit down and be bored, but she hates being bored. What do you do? But, a funny, smart and cheeky lass is she, if you can ever find her, that is.
Tayla: The Unfinished Masterpiece, maybe, but she hasn’t got time for a tour of the gallery, that’s for sure. Tayla is a hands-on chick who does everything and more that’s asked of her, and so much so that now she’s just about running the fucking company.
Taylah: The canvas of the masterpiece that is about to begin……(Is she in a bad mood? Yes? Okay, move out and come back when she's settled, and when she's got her colours selected.)
Taylor: Taylor is a tall, let’s-not-fuck-around bombshell.
Tayu: Shiny black hair. Dark humorous eyes. What mysteries lie behind them? How will her tiny frame cope with the world? What great deeds are yet to be done? And great deeds, it seems, are what’s in store.....
Taz: As a set of shark’s jaws in a natural history museum, Taz is exotic and fascinating but pick the jaws up in your hands and you’ll tell a different story; the teeth are so sharp you won’t even know you are being cut. So, friends and lovers, bring gloves, expect the unexpected and take your time.
Teagan: Check-out chick, potentially, yes. But never forget that when the cameras aren't on her, Teagan is as cunning as a bushrat!
Tean: Bored with her lot, Tean needs to break some shackles. Help her if you can, but it’s her decision to make.
Tebani:
As the author Robert Hughes famously said once, "I'm not a snob. I just like beautiful things."

Tebani enjoys silk on her body, if she's on a yacht then it better be a thing of beauty with a stunning teak deck, and she won't tolerate any bad behaviour towards her or anyone else. But as we implied, she ain't no snob. She's smart enough to know we can all learn from each other if our eyes are open to new ways of thinking, and to humour especially. And yeah, she's sexy and cool and people adore her and all that, just don't bore her by constantly reminding her. If you're a potential suitor and you're the jealous type, we suggest you keep on walking.
Teegan: Ever seen those army ads on TV, where a demure, happy young woman is standing in front of a giant army truck laden with vital helicopter parts, emergency supplies or even a small platoon of scared young men? Well, the army would never admit it publicly, but even they know that Teegan effectively owns that vehicle and Teegan, herself, is bloody proud of what she can do with it. She even knows how to fix it.
Teegs: The search party gave her up for dust weeks ago. Stranded in croc-country, everyone thought she’d been eaten. Far from it. She turned up yesterday with a rifle slung over her shoulder, and looking better than ever. In fact you couldn’t wipe the smile of her face. She’s now talking about leading camping tours out there. Teegs.
Teen: Teen is unique in the Kingdom in that she isn’t really an Enigma, and she isn’t really one of the Gifted Ones. She is, however, some combination of the two in that her name rhymes with Comfortable and it rhymes with Yes. The trade-off for her is that she wears her foibles on her sleeve and for that she receives our thanks and our unshakeable love.
Tegan: Was she a check-out chick? Okay, well, what's she doing now? She went back to school? Are you serious? GREAT!...She wants to go to uni?? Well bugger me! Good for her.
Teha: Teha is a nice girl but a stiff breeze, be it real or analogous, would blow her over.
Teila: Teila is better at organising her friends than her own bedroom. Not exactly obsessed with the state of the planet and its current woes, Teila’s personal radar extends from her house, to work, to her boyfriend’s and to her favourite shopping precinct. Not prone to dilly-dallying, Teila moves fast, especially when she knows what she wants, be it vodka or some hot loving. (She has a personalised number plate, and yes, she's good at the hot loving part.)
Teleah: The currents of life carry her down her own river, usually without the need for her to actively steer herself. She could do with more snags in her life, to be honest, only because they provide moments of reflection. Who knows, maybe she’ll put that rudder in the water sooner than you think?
Teleisha: Extremely reactionary. She's the sort of girl who will accidentally tread on her own small makeup jar in her own bedroom and then scream blue murder, even though she's the one who left it there. And this despite being told repeatedly to put things away. She drives you nuts.
Temperance: Mmmm, her parents sent her off to that boarding school in Switzerland. On Monday they speak English, Tuesday French, Wednesday Spanish, Thursday German and Friday Italian. It might be the extravagance that the Italian language imbibes, that and the fact that it happens on a Friday, because Temperance parties hard with in-crowd all weekend. Yes, she sneaks out of her window and sneaks back, all under the cover of darkness. If only her parents knew......
Tenaya: Tenacious? You bet. A little bit lost? Sure, but many of us probably are.
Teneale: If Teneale isn't busy on a particular task then please ensure she has one. Yes, that little frown will always be there but, secretly, she loves it when she isn't sitting idle. The larger and more complex the project (ie. function/relationship/recipe/route to get somewhere) the happier her soul will be. She's alot smarter than she lets on.
Tenelle: The good, constant, pure drum beat.
Tenisha: Tenisha, for someone as smart as you, who is such a good and quick reader of people, why are  you working in a fucking fish n' chip shop? What are you waiting for girl?
Tera: No, she's not a terror. She's just lazy.
Teresa: I don’t know if it still happens today but back in the old days you used to put Teresa in with the shirts to make them stiff and white. Does that still happen? (ie: If you want an opinion which is 110% truthful, or if you want to get something done, or perhaps you're about to head into battle in some for or other, get her over.)
Terese: If she was dying on a mountain-side after a heavy fall, amid a situation which was dire for everyone, she'd insist that those trying to help her eat her after she passed away. She's that kind of girl. (She’s never late for work.)
Teri: The tomboys usually have it over the rest of the females in the room. No one knows why. Perhaps men just need to toughen up, who knows. Anyway, Teri is cute and funny and present. Not bad eh?
Terra-lea: Another rock climber, except she's busted more bones in her arms and wrists than anyone.
Terran: Terran looks stern but she actually isn't at all. What she enjoys, is that pass-time called fishing, and if she doesn't angle then she should. Why? Because fishing involves many of the things in life which she appreciates: being self-sufficient, spending time in a nice setting either on her own or with selected company, and turning acquired knowledge into physical action. So don't give Terran new perfume for Christmas. Instead, buy her something useful, like a good filleting knife or an expensive set of new lures
Terri: (One of) the Gods gave her that name in the same way insurance companies give you a cover note between cars. That is, Terri is relaxing in this life while she is between two highly energetic universes, and so what she was called while she was here was always going to be irrelevant. Terri is her name and Terri gets on with it: end of story.
Terrianne: Terrianne makes a tremendous scout troupe leader, tour guide or vigilante. As a no-nonsense, hands-on lass, Terrianne likes to be in the thick of it and she leads by example. Sure, she's been in a blue or two, but only for a good cause. And yes, her ego enjoys being the centre of attention, although this is never a deliberate ploy. By default she enjoys helping people but only those willing to help themselves. For example, if her and her scout group are on a desert island for an exercise on self-reliance, the first thing she will do is grit her hunting knife in her teeth and scale the first coconut palm in search of coconuts, and she'll expect you to have a go as well.
Terrill: No, Terrill isn't terrible. She's independent, she's smart, she knows how to work through a problem and she's not into dainty girlie clothes or ditzy behaviour.
Terryl: Terryl is the treasurer of the local country gold club and a no-nonsense woman. She never misses a meeting, you never see her without her golf hat, whether you see her down the street or out on the course, and she is staunchly loyal to her members.
Tesla: Sure, she has an odd name (and no, she’s not a robot) but she couldn’t give a fuck. Tesla is ambitious, she’s busy and she doesn’t have time for another fucking conversation about what her parents were thinking. She ignores the crowd and puts others first. Nice one T.
Tess: Take note: that hard-arse bitch exterior is just a bullshit front. Be patient, take your time, ignore the quips and go discover someone quite lovely and peculiar. Go on...
Thayla: A reader. A studier. A potential academic. She sits in her room obsessed not with her iphone, her itouch, her itweet, or some other ipad-device, but with good old fashion books. Better than that, most of what she reads seems to stick in her memory and as a result she knows way more about the world than any of her peers. She'll do very well at university, and she might even aim to make the world a better place. And amen if she does.
Thelma: Thelma attacks cooking in la cucina like a werewolf attacks its victim. She wears no shoes but she loves long, flowing Mexican skirts, and she dances with her grandchildren, ensuring there is enough flour on the floor so it can be kicked everywhere.
Theodora: Too big to be a jockey, Theodora employs a team that designs either clothes or curtains. Maybe she imports carpets, it's hard to say. What Theodora brings to the table is a highly evolved sense of composition and colour, a loud and gregarious nature and the capacity to spot a bullshit artist a mile away. After all, it takes one to know one.
Theresa: Theresa's favourite event on the calender is the Running of the Bulls in Pamplona, Spain. And, no, she doesn't go just to watch…...
Therese: In another one of those unique blends, Therese is a mixture of Lynn, Nancy and Bruce.
Therlene:
Wow, isn't Therlene a ball of laughter! (Just kidding.) You know that big, gruff woman who holds you down and then helps put on your straight jacket?
Yep. Therlene. We suggest you don’t mess with her.
Thomina: Monotony and tedium: Thomina will battle those two head-on in a fight that doesn't, and can't, last very long. Pugnacious and funny, Thomina has never sat idle. Who knows what she does for a living, but we shudder to think of how she'd cope if she busted her knee skiing and was laid up in bed for weeks in traction. Her phone would cop a hammering, that's for sure.
Thommo: The delectable woman who occasionally suffers at the hands of a manly nickname, making her sound less sensitive and feminine than she actually is. As a trade-off she’s shit-hot when the chips are down and sufficiently gorgeous and lovely, anyway.
Tia: Tia is fun and glorious on the surface until you get her angry, or you get her on an off-day, then she’ll bare her teeth like an unpredictable Ridgeback.
Tiaani: With a name that resembles a $15,000 pearl necklace, Tiaani is either as sweet, as relaxed and as playful as can be, or she's the other extreme of the egocentric cow who has her head buried so far up her own arse that it isn't funny. You're dealing with the former, right?
Tiana: Tiana works in the make-up department of any of the big chain department stores. Goes out with Ryan. What she really wants to do, is travel. So, what you waiting for, girl? Ditch that drinkin' man and get out there!
Tianna: No, she has no idea how the government functions, but I suppose not many people do. As someone who deals with personal secrets and rumour-mills very well, she'd probably do well in politics, actually. Be that as it may Tianna tends not to deal with the Big Picture all that well. This second, that dress, this moment, that problematic phone number from that idiot who keeps calling and who hasn't got the hint yet - this is where she functions best. Please don't hassle her with things like a career or long-term responsibilities!
Tiarne: Generally, you wont find her on a mountain top in the Andes having conquered the top five peaks, having recently buried three of her team members, but, and it's a mighty fine but, if she gets her passionate juices up then she will walk a gun-barrel line to achieve her ambition and she'll do it without any fanfare. However, if she’s just bumbling along without any major purpose then Tiarne will get sucked along by the group quite happily. And no, she’s not a hippy.
Tiarni: At some point in her life Tiarni will find herself handing out brochures, election propoganda or perhaps nightclub-promotion pamplets, and deep down she wont really care about any of it. But, with that big, friendly grin you'd never know. In a nutshell, Tiarni is a modern gal' living in a modern world, which is largely constructed upon a set of laws that are completely false. She does well in it too, but her task in life is to dig a little deeper. And if you can help it, T, work for yourself and not someone else.
Tiate: Tiate is spritely and generally lovely, but she looks so far ahead she’s nearly cumbersome to deal with in the here-and-now.
Tiech: As a teacher, of sorts, Tiech is the social, advisory and entertainment hub for all of her friends, of which there are many. She’d be okay without them but they’d be screwed without her.
Tiegan: Quiet and well-mannered, petite and demure……CODS WOLLOP!!!! Tiegan is, THE TRANSFORMER!!
Tiff: Lively, light-hearted and way more laid back than Tiffany will ever be, Tiff is here to have a good time and get it done. Behind the tomboy veneer is a staunch romantic and it takes a fair bit for her to become visible angry. Tiff is lovely.
Tiffany: Tiffany plays the bangles in any rock band and she has a big hairdo. Tell her she’s a gifted artist and she’ll be your friend forever.
Tigerlily: Okay, so her mum is a little bit insane, but perhaps she knew something we’re all only learning just now? You see, Tigerlily had it sussed even when she was a little girl. Business, love, philosophy - all of it. So do yourself a favour, get her business card and make an appointment with her. She might very well change your life. The End.
Tijana: Tijana would do quite well as the leader of a mafioso clan. Why? Because she looks great, she speaks her mind, all her finances are a complete and utter mystery and at her disposal are people who can deal with ANY situation. You with me?
Tilly: Tilly wears glasses and she’s abit scatty. She’s sweet as pie until she gets catty.
Timna: If you want normality you better go somewhere else. Timna broke all the moulds when she arrived, so much so that many mould-makers lost their job. But, it all turned out okay because Timna is a curled up little ball of energy and punch, she's funny and she's here to laugh. Most of all she's here to travel and discover. She likes wood in her house.
Tina: The Tina is the act of ripping off a bandaid that’s been on the back of your leg for ages, and she is the whole journey; the psyching up, the fear of the pain, the pain of the rip and the blessed relief that arrives afterwards when you discover that the wound has healed nicely.
Tiona: Tiona spends 3-days every week in jewellery shops poring over displays of wedding rings, and whether she's married, engaged or single.
Tmeya: “Give it to me,” she says, placating the person who matters with a luxurious kiss on the cheek. “What are you doing? When was the last time you heard of anyone mixing tomato sauce with their beluga?”
Tobiain:
Hostage negotiation: perhaps this is where she should have ended up? Tobiain possesses an almost obsessive desire to achieve her ambitions and I wonder if she wasn't born about 600 years too late? We imagine her in a time when, if displeased with an answer from an underling, she might just pull out her sword and take their head off. Is this why she stalks the corridors of her modern work place looking slightly dissatisfied? (Because deep down, in the recesses of her ancestral DNA, she knows that all these modern wankers need to be removed, and removed mortally!)
Breath deeply baby, and retain a sense of humour at all cost: this is our only advice.
Toby: Toby is like the Energizer battery bunny on TV ads because she never gives up, except that she’s far more alluring and definitely not a fuckwit.
Toia: How is it some people just encourage you to be better? We've been discussing this in the commentary box for some time now and we're still struggling to come to terms with the mechanism. Toia, for instance, is one of only a handful of players in the Kingdom who run on to the field and are applauded by the opposition. How bizarre is that? You can see the craziness of it, can't you? If her team mates are applauding, and their fans, and the opposition team and the opposition fans, that means everyone is applauding. It pisses us off up here in the box because we end up applauding too! What does she do for a job?...Fuck knows. Who cares? We’re just relieved she's playing, full stop.
Toneya: Her idea of a perfect night out is the local pub where a cover band plays rock songs at a volume so loud she can barely hear anything the next day, which doesn't combine that well with her hangover. (She doesn't care about that. All she knows is that the lead singer reminds her of Jon Bon Jovi, and that's what counts.)
Toni: Toni heads to where she is going on one of the most direct routes possible. Her tomboy heritage made her that way, but it didn't quell her sense of fun or adventure. Don't ever assume that. Furthermore, Toni is one of the most powerful and underrated breaths of sexy fresh air in the entire kingdom. Now that you know this, you may as well go say hello...
Toni-Ann: Fuck, look out because here comes a modern, potent symbol of womanhood! All of her friends (and lovers) trail her like the wake off the back of a very large, very expensive and very powerful boat. Our advice? Don’t let go. You certainly won’t forget her if you meet her. Amen.
Tonia: Whippet-like. Tonia is one of the most organised and antsy people in the Kingdom. Every ounce of her soul is busy continually preparing for something, such that if she is feeling cocky, she might even attempt to schedule the timing of her visits to the loo, for the following day.
Tony: The gorgeous, the brilliant and the incredibly ambitious lawyer. Just watch her go....
Toorah: The in-your-face actress/adventurer/soothsayer who tends to blow people away.
Toosje: Like a young child accidentally farting, Toosje makes even the most banal chores interesting, funny and often startling. How is that? We have no idea. It might be her cheeky grin or her 'the-cup-is-only-ever-overflowing' attitude which is contagious, who knows? Her life operates in the same way a novice gymnast attempts their first double somersault dismount, but accidentally does three somersaults and still manages to land on her feet, looking just as surprised as anyone. She is therefore loved by just about everybody.
Tori: “....Why make something simple when I can freak out and let it ruin my life? Tell me, why? Why would I do that? Make my life simple, I mean….why? Who needs a simple life, anyway?”.....etc etc.
Toya: Yeah, she toys with mens' hearts alright but rarely deliberately, at least not these days! Not that many of the fellows realise it at the time but she's doing them a favour. In life she can be frustrating to deal with only because she changes her mind from minute to minute, making it damn-near impossible to plan anything. We've suggested she try to slow down a bit but that never worked, and her bedroom looks like a bomb's gone off.
Trace: A fart in a country pub: generally unnoticed and often funny, she’s a splendid reminder of those things that make each of us splendidly human.
Tracey: The professional tennis player who is far more skilled at the game when she’s warming up: She has an excellent scowl on her forehead that you know isn’t all that serious, she looks fantastic and very professional in her tennis skirt and her technique at hitting a pretend ball is dramatic and flawless. When the actual game begins, however, her shots start flying everywhere and I don’t think she’s won a Grand Slam event, yet. But, she tries very hard and for this we must be, and are, very thankful. (And both of you, stop complaining about the bloody spelling!)
Tracy: The professional tennis player who is far more skilled at the game when she’s warming up: She has an excellent scowl on her forehead that you know isn’t all that serious, she looks fantastic and very professional in her tennis skirt and her technique at hitting a pretend ball is dramatic and flawless. When the actual game begins, however, her shots start flying everywhere and I don’t think she’s won a Grand Slam event, yet. But, she tries very hard and for this we must be, and are, very thankful.
Tram:
Tram is special because she seems to have... 



all the time



in the world.
Treena: Treena doesn't really dwell on the past. She’ll forgive once, maybe twice but never a third time - the occasionally idiotic boyfriend being the single exception. Her friendly approach makes her appear flippant, she’s not. She’s just into life.
Treg: Forever the optimist, her scowls are really only used for comic purposes, deep down. Sure, she could be a ball-buster but she rarely allows situations or people to become that problematic, and she makes her decisions quickly. And if a decision is ‘incorrect’, she will make the best of things. Treg is young at heart, she’s never a slacker (well, not usually, but she is human) and she perpetually seeks play-time, which means she’ll enjoy herself in ALL facets of life, way way up into a ripe old age. Amen Treg.
Trichelle: There is a separate room in her house that contains nothing but jewellery.
Trijntje: Looking at her name makes one feel like an air crash investigator arriving at the scene of a catastrophic accident for the first time. But here's the thing - it looks weird, and you'd think it sounds weird, but it doesn't. It's actually quite a smooth name. I mean, no one knows how to pronounce it, but that exact reaction means the owner cant possibly be as complex and neurotic as you'd imagine. Indeed, Trijntje is just a normal kind of lass. She has friends, she's not as outrageous as people think, and she's hardly crashed her car drunk. Not bad eh? (And yes, regardless if she avoids rehab or not, she secretly loves being just a little bit different!)
Trilby: Irrepressible. Trilby can barely wipe the smile off her face. Her multi-coloured clothes seem to match the trail of fans who seem to follow her every move. Classically-speaking she’s not even famous, but even if she were the paparazzi wouldn't be able to get near her anyway.
Trin: Like a magnet, she attracts men, women and all other energetic entities. (Unstable 54% of the time.)
Trina: She’ll never make CEO of Rio Tinto but she’s a highly energetic woman who manages to be quite economical at the same time.
Trinity: Trinity blazes away without bothering to aim the rifle properly.
Trisa: Trisa is a girl in a hurry. We don't know why.
Trish: Trish is a laid back larrikin who deals with danger in her stride, until the cruise liner that she’s travelling on, via the competition she won, hits something and begins to sink, and sink quite quickly. Then she screams as much as she laughs.
Trisha: The textbook Drama Queen! Lovely, yes, but she's still a Drama Queen.
Trisha-Rose:
You've seen her in those movies. You know the ones. A battle is about to take place between gladiators in a Roman-style colusseum, and somehow the brave, muscular and daring young warrior, out there in the middle and faced with death, got around to meeting the cloistered young princess weeks before in a social setting, via unlikely events.

The sight of him sets her heart aflutter, but she can't give her reaction away. Not here, dressed in extravagant robes and seated next to her petulant Emporer father.

She must save him, and she must also save herself. She isn't stupid. So, how can she employ her refined and impeccable persona to pull this off and save face at the same time?…Only a Trisha-Rose could accomplish this.
Trista: Trista doesn’t seek shelter. She gets out there and bloody-well rips into it. A sparkle in her eye attracts everyone and everything, and what a journey she is on. We urge you to watch and be entertained.
Trixie: Funny, irreverent and forgetful, yes, in a past life Trixie was a hooker but so what - many of the best people were because deep down they are (and were) a lover of people. At least, they aim/aimed to be!
Trudi: Trudi visits Asia almost solely for the rickshaw rides. The louder and the more dangerous the traffic, the better. Luckily, most of the drivers and riders seem to know what they're doing, and Trudi is a good passenger because, like it or loathe it, she trusts people.
Trudy: Trudy is a bit rudy. She’s had an eventful upbringing but, overall, she’s compensated with poise.
True:
Quick question for you True: Are your parents okay?
On the plus side, at least they didn't call you Maybe, or False, or I'll Have To Think About It. That would have been a catastrophe.
Imagine that? "Oh hi. My name is Impossible, nice to meet  you."
See what I mean?
(For the record, True is lovely, and a little bit shy, and she has a heart of gold.)
Truth: Question: should nouns be permitted? The fact is, she (and we) delight in those moments when the truth is none of her business. It’s turned her into a feisty competitor, and she has no qualms about approaching a man (if she is a straight-shooter) and asking him out on a first date. Go you good thing!
Tuhi: Tuhi’s ancestors used to paddle around New Zealand in canoes and eat any visitors that showed up, and she has lost none of that zest for life. As Maoris go, Tuhi is a gem but the standard warnings apply to her as to all Kiwis: If she is pissed or partying hard, either call the police or hop in your car and leave for a couple of days (unless, of course, you want to see something spectacular, in which case I’d recommend sticking around).
Tuoya: If you can, I'd like you to imagine yourself deep in the bowels of an ancient temple. You pull back the stone lid on some kind of ancient box and blow away the accumulated dust. It's a wooden contraption - small - and gently you pry it open. The hinges still work perfectly and you gasp at what you find. It's the world's oldest and, now, most expensive Backgammon board. These guys must have been playing this 6000 years ago. How is that possible? On gut instinct, however, you and your party deem it fitting to kneel down before the board in a moment of prayer, paying homage to Tuoya, which is the name of the game. She's fun, she goes back deeper than you can imagine and not just anyone can play.
Tuscany: As a modern-day Zachary, one might ask why (or think it's fortunate) Tuscany wasn't called South Carolina, or Suffolk, or Ontario, but that's another story! If Tuscany can avoid a substance abuse issue in her teens, then she will possess not one evil bone in her body, and that's a good thing. In this case, Tuscany is rarely glum or pessimistic, and she is the kind of the girl who, in preparation for a visit by friends, will place a clean folded towel upon each guest's bed with a new bar of soap sitting on top, as well as a vase of fresh flowers on the dresser. Does this make the guest feel like Tuscany is somewhat clichéd? Well, I suppose it might, but you can't say she isn't doing her best to make people feel welcome, and amen to that. Sarcasm is none of her business.
Twiggy: Sexy, funny, loud and impossible to keep up with.
Twyla: Clive is the clumsiest animal in the Kingdom, no question, but Twyla gives him a damn good run for his money. I shudder to think how many houses they'd burn down and how many cars they'd right-off if they ever got together as a couple. Aside from that, Twyla is a happy, vivacious girl by and large, who is always surprised by things. It's actually quite endearing, so long as she's not flying an aeroplane, or some such contraption.
Ty: Technicalities: she loves them. Ty is a wonderful auditor of any system, be it a family she's a part of, a company she's helping to organise, or a relationship she's endeavoring to maintain, but she's not so strict that proves she doesn't have either a sense of humour or a deep understanding of human frailty. She does. And she's deceptively sensual as well.  You got all that?
Tyen: To describe her as meek is incorrect. Mild-mannered is more apt, but even then, inside her mind she is anything but. On the surface she seems quite aloof, and perhaps she is. Awareness of her surroundings is pretty good and so when she feels like she needs to act/speak/move/talk/react, she will. Chances are she thinks most of the crap she is surrounded by is not worth worrying about, which is why she might look a little bored sometimes. I can't say I blame her. Give her something to really get her teeth into and THEN you'll see this girl move! Oh, and by the way, in that situation do what she says, okay, because she knows what she's talking about.
Tylah: Tylah doesn't handle coming second in anything very well.
Tyler: I don't recommend it as a means to stay alive,  but Tyler can somehow text while she's driving and not diminish her skill behind the wheel one bit. (Note: Tyler, baby, seriously, do you want to keep living or not? Management. X)
Tynysha: Her life goal is to one day own a caravan bigger than the one she was born in.
Tyrese: Always the predator, never the prey. And while that is the truth, she's not quite as harsh as that statement sounds.
Tyrin: Tyrin seems to enjoy going it alone and she doesn't mind roughing it. She'd make an excellent solo fisherwoman who heads out to sea with her little dog for days at a time.
Tzena: Tzena is a beautiful woman who thinks and acts with her heart, and her hair, like her personality, is never straight.
Téya: Like an unserviced helicopter, Téya is expensive, complex to fly at the best of times and, on a bad day, terribly dangerous…
